server.name: zernote-mcp
server.description: Zernote is a product for founders and researchers. To work through a startup idea, call get-skills (office hours and playbooks). To work with interviews, insights, JTBD, or uploads — use the other tools.

live.instructions:
Zernote research MCP. No account is required to start.

Playbooks first (no login): tool get-skills.
Before answering a product idea, office hours, brainstorm, research plan, or "help me think this through" — and before projects_read / interviews_read / search / insights / jtbd:
1. Call get-skills with no id (catalog).
2. Call get-skills with the matching id and follow that skill. Do not answer the idea from memory.
A connected Zernote account is not a reason to list projects.
If no skill fits: get-skills with no id, then office-hours-zernote. Questions immediately. Minimum text before the first question.
After intake, write the profile to Claude/Cursor memory if available; otherwise keep it in this session. Then get-skills catalog again and offer the matching playbook.
Skills work without an account. Data tools do not — use them only when the user asks about their interviews/insights or a loaded skill says to. If they have no account, they register on the Zernote site during Sign in. Do not invent interviews or projects.

Authenticated tools (projects, interviews, search, insights, JTBD, upload) need a Zernote login. Call them when the user needs their data so the host can show Sign in. Until then, only get-skills and skill:// resources.

Playbook catalog (get-skills id=… for the full body):
- office-hours-zernote: YC Office Hours. After loading this skill, open the greeting picker at once. The picker prompt is the prod YC hello (what YC is, who graduated), then shall we start. No user-research Airbnb/Stripe story at the start. ...
- zernote-plan-research: Plan talks with users from an office-hours design doc. Needs that doc and an explicit yes. Writes one call guide: opening, screener, question pack, then close with product, price, and buy. Then hands off to zernote-fi...
- zernote-find-respondents: Find people to interview right after zernote-plan-research saved the call guide. Asks whether anyone around them could use the product, then the budget. Always starts with their own network, then free/trial outreach, ...

tools.name: get-skills
tools.title: Startup ideas / office hours
tools.description: Use for startup ideas, office hours, and “I installed this connector to work through an idea”. Inside: office-hours-zernote (challenge the idea), zernote-plan-research. Omit id for the catalog, then pass id for the full playbook. Not for listing interviews or projects. Works without login.

id.description: Skill id. Empty = catalog. Examples: office-hours-zernote, zernote-plan-research.

tools.name: projects_read
tools.title: Projects Read
tools.description: Read existing research folders. Not for a new startup idea or office hours — call get-skills first. action=list returns projects for the authenticated user.

limit.description: Max number of projects to return (default 50, max 200).

offset.description: Number of projects to skip before returning results (default 0).

tools.name: projects_edit
tools.title: Projects Edit
tools.description: Create or rename projects. action=create needs name; action=rename needs id and name. Delete is not supported yet.

name.description: Project name (required for create and rename).

tools.name: guides_read
tools.title: Guides Read
tools.description: Read the interview guide stored on a project. The guide has an intro, ordered blocks (title, minutes, questions, notes), total time, a notes template, and any markdown that did not parse. Returns an empty guide when the project has none.

tools.name: guides_create
tools.title: Guides Create
tools.description: Create the first interview guide on a project. Use this to upload a new guide. Pass structured fields, not markdown: intro, blocks (title, minutes, notes, questions with text/note/key), and notes_template. Needs at least one block with a title. Fails if the project already has a guide — then use guides_edit. Core does not show the guide. Live reads it on the project.

notes.description: Block note shown to the interviewer.

key.description: True if this is a must-ask question.

intro.description: Spoken opening before the first block.

tools.name: guides_edit
tools.title: Guides Edit
tools.description: Replace an existing interview guide from markdown. To create the first guide, call guides_create. Text before the first ## is the intro. ## Title (12) or ## Title (7–11) is a block; minutes are the last number in parentheses. Lines starting with - or 1. are questions; a leading * marks a key question; the next indented line is the question note. A paragraph under the block heading before the first question is the block note. ## Конспект is the post-interview notes template, not a block. Optional line `Общее время: 30` or `Total: 30` sets total minutes; otherwise they are the sum of block minutes. Anything that does not match is returned in remainder and kept, not dropped. The previous guide is replaced entirely.

markdown.description: Full guide markdown. Replaces the guide stored on the project.

tools.name: interviews_read
tools.title: Interviews Read
tools.description: Read interviews. Typical path: (1) action=list with summary_mode=brief (default) — returns the short # Summary. List items include need_approve_speakers (+ pending_speakers / hint): when true, show interviewer quote links then confirm via assign_speakers; one identity confirm backfills other interviews sharing voice_identity_id. Use summary_mode=brief for renaming or folder triage. Use summary_mode=full when Profile/Tools/Pains/Other topics are needed for deeper analysis. (2) call `search` when you need evidence or counter-evidence for a hypothesis; (3) use action=transcript with around_chunk_index from matching_chunks when a quote window is required. CITATION REQUIRED: when answering the user, actively cite evidence as markdown ["verbatim quote"]({base_url}/project/interview/{id}?t={seconds}) using interview_url / matching chunk url from tool results (includes ?t= when start_seconds is set). Prefer quotes over paraphrase.

action.description: Read action. Use list (brief or summary_mode=full) for overview; use transcript when you need a quote window.

around_chunk_index.description: Transcript only: expand a window around this vector-search chunk_index (use instead of blind offset when available).

id.description: Interview UUID (required for get, status, transcript).

inbox_only.description: When true with action=list, list Inbox interviews (no project). Ignored if project_id is set.

limit.description: For list: max interviews (default 20, max 100). For transcript: max characters (default 4000, max 20000).

notes_mode.description: List only. none (default) = omit notes body. full = researcher notes (truncated on list). Use summary when notes are not required.

offset.description: For list: skip count. For transcript without around_chunk_index: character offset (default 0).

project_id.description: Optional project UUID to filter list (alias: folder_id).

radius_chars.description: Transcript only with around_chunk_index: chars before/after chunk match (default 1500, max 8000).

summary_mode.description: List only. brief (default) = short # Summary for triage/rename. full = all summary_fragments (profile/tools/pains/other_topics) when brief is insufficient.

tools.name: interviews_edit
tools.title: Interviews Edit
tools.description: Rename, move, write summary/notes, retranscribe, assign/confirm speakers, or toggle voiceprint. action=rename needs id+title; move needs interview_ids (+ optional project_id); write_summary needs id+summary; write_notes needs id+notes; retranscribe needs id+language (charges transcription tokens again; analyze-only, keeps notes). assign_speakers needs id+speaker_labels+assigned_names. For voiceprint interviewer confirm: one label + real name on one interview after quote links; that identity backfills other interviews sharing voice_identity_id — re-list instead of confirming every card. set_voiceprint needs enabled bool (false purges biometric voice data). If need_approve_speakers=true, show quote links then assign_speakers when the user confirms. If transcript_quality.looks_corrupted=true, offer retranscribe with the correct language. write_notes and write_summary replace the entire notes or summary field (not append).

assigned_names.description: Human names matching speaker_labels (assign_speakers). Use a real name, not "Interviewer N".

enabled.description: Voiceprint on/off (set_voiceprint). false deletes stored voice biometrics.

id.description: Interview UUID (rename, write_summary, write_notes, retranscribe, assign_speakers).

language.description: Transcription language code for retranscribe (e.g. en, ru, nl). Charges tokens for audio duration.

notes.description: Full note text that replaces the existing notes field (write_notes).

project_id.description: Destination project UUID for move (alias: folder_id). Omit or null for Inbox.

speaker_labels.description: Diarization labels to assign (assign_speakers), e.g. ["A"]. Voiceprint interviewer confirm: one label in this call (same identity then backfills other interviews).

summary.description: Full summary markdown that replaces the existing summary (write_summary). Expected sections: # Summary, ## Profile, ## Tools & workflow, ## Pains & friction, # Other topics.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Semantic search for evidence / counter-evidence after you have interview context (e.g. from list/summary). Optional interview_id scopes search to one interview and returns smaller text windows. Returns matching_chunks[{chunk_index, text, similarity, start_seconds?, url}]. CITATION REQUIRED: actively cite hits to the user as markdown ["verbatim quote from text"]({base_url}/project/interview/{id}?t={seconds}) using each chunk's url field from the tool result (already absolute; includes ?t= when start_seconds is present). Prefer quoting matching_chunks over paraphrase. Expand with interviews_read action=transcript around_chunk_index when a wider quote window is needed.

chunks_limit.description: Max matching chunks per interview (default 3 corpus / 8 when interview_id set; max 10 / 20).

chunks_offset.description: Skip this many top chunks per interview (default 0).

interview_id.description: Optional interview UUID — search only inside this interview; returns smaller chunk windows.

limit.description: Max number of interviews to return (default 5, max 10). Ignored when interview_id is set.

query.description: Natural language search query (hypothesis / claim to evidence).

tools.name: cards_read
tools.title: Cards Read
tools.description: List L2 coded claim-cards (claim + optional quote + chunk_index + lens + codes + start_seconds? + url). Filter by project_id, interview_id / interview_ids, codes (any match), or lens (workflow|gtm|privacy|other). CITATION REQUIRED: actively cite each card.quote to the user as markdown ["verbatim quote"]({base_url}/project/interview/{id}?t={seconds}) using item.url from the tool result (already absolute; includes ?t= when start_seconds is set). Prefer quotes over paraphrase. Verify with interviews_read action=transcript around_chunk_index when a wider quote window is needed.

codes.description: Optional code tags; any match (e.g. pain:synthesis, gtm:pricing).

interview_id.description: Optional interview UUID to scope cards.

interview_ids.description: Optional interview UUIDs to scope cards.

project_id.description: Optional project UUID — cards from interviews in this project (alias: folder_id).

tools.name: insights_read
tools.title: Insights Read
tools.description: Read the project Insights graph in pages or by node. action=list returns a compact folder-wide outline (groups + interviews) plus a page of insight bodies. Filter with interview_id, group_id (DB UUID, not UI group-0), group_name, insight_ids, or ungrouped_only. action=get_node returns one node: insight | interview | group | ungrouped. CITATION REQUIRED: actively cite each item.quote as markdown ["verbatim quote"]({base_url}/project/interview/{id}?t={seconds}) using item.url from the tool result (already absolute; includes ?t= when start_seconds is set). Prefer quotes over paraphrase. Do not use quote_start — that is a character offset, not a player timestamp.

action.description: list = paged insight bodies + outline. get_node = one insight, interview, group, or ungrouped cluster.

group_id.description: List filter: insight_groups.id UUID (not a render index like group-0).

group_name.description: List filter: case-insensitive group name match.

id.description: get_node: insight, interview, or group UUID. Not used for ungrouped.

insight_ids.description: List filter: only these insight UUIDs.

interview_id.description: List filter: only insights from this interview. Interview must be in the project.

limit.description: List only: max insight bodies (default 25, max 100).

offset.description: List only: skip this many matching insight bodies (default 0).

project_id.description: Project/folder UUID (required for list and for get_node group/ungrouped/insight).

ungrouped_only.description: List filter: only insights that are not in a cross-interview group.

tools.name: jtbd_read
tools.title: JTBD Read
tools.description: Read JTBD job graph segments and trees. action=list_segments needs folder_id/project_id. action=get_tree needs segment_id or interview_id. CITATION REQUIRED: cite job quotes as ["text"](interview_url).

tools.name: jtbd_edit
tools.title: JTBD Edit
tools.description: Edit JTBD graph: extract_interview, move_interview, create_segment, fill_in job, update_job, delete_job.

language.description: Job tree language for extract_interview (en or ru). Defaults to en. Quotes stay in the interview language.

tools.name: upload_interview
tools.title: Upload Interview
tools.description: Opens the in-Claude MCP Apps widget "Upload To Zernote" so the user can drop a file into Inbox in this chat (audio/video max 2GB; text .txt/.md or PDF max 50MB). Use when the user wants to upload/add an interview or get started on an empty account — this is the usual ingest path in Claude. Audio/video starts transcription; text/PDF become ready immediately (no speaker diarization). Claude can name interviews after upload.

tools.name: mcp_prepare_upload
tools.title: Prepare Upload
tools.description: App-only: create an Inbox interview and return a presigned R2 upload URL (or multipart upload_id for large files). Pass interview_id (+ upload_id for multipart) to resume without a new card.

interview_id.description: Optional: existing empty interview UUID — resume upload without creating a new card.

title.description: Optional interview title (defaults to sanitized filename).

upload_id.description: Optional multipart upload id from a previous prepare (resume).

tools.name: mcp_sign_upload_parts
tools.title: Sign Upload Parts
tools.description: App-only: return presigned R2 URLs for one or more multipart upload parts (resume-safe).

tools.name: mcp_confirm_upload
tools.title: Confirm Upload
tools.description: App-only: confirm a completed R2 upload (single PUT or multipart) for an Inbox interview. Audio/video is enqueued for transcription (STT + diarization). Text (.txt/.md) and PDF are stored and marked ready immediately — no transcription.

language.description: STT language for audio/video (e.g. en, ru, nl). Not used for text/PDF (no transcription).

multipart_parts.description: Completed parts (part_number + etag) when using multipart.

multipart_upload_id.description: Multipart upload id — complete assembly before confirm.

title.description: Optional title to apply before confirm.

controls.description: Full summary markdown that replaces the existing summary (write_summary). Expected sections: # Summary, ## Profile, ## Tools & workflow, ## Pains & friction, # Other topics.

controls.name: chunks_limit
controls.description: Max matching chunks per interview (default 3 corpus / 8 when interview_id set; max 10 / 20).

controls.name: limit
controls.description: Max number of interviews to return (default 5, max 10). Ignored when interview_id is set.

controls.name: limit
controls.description: List only: max insight bodies (default 25, max 100).

controls.name: offset
controls.description: List only: skip this many matching insight bodies (default 0).

flags.description: Max number of projects to return (default 50, max 200).
flags.hypothesis: Default may exceed a narrow task’s context needs. Numeric threshold >=50 is a screening heuristic, not a measured response size.

flags.description: Rename, move, write summary/notes, retranscribe, assign/confirm speakers, or toggle voiceprint. action=rename needs id+title; move needs interview_ids (+ optional project_id); write_summary needs id+summary; write_notes needs id+notes; retranscribe needs id+language (charges transcription tokens again; analyze-only, keeps notes). assign_speakers needs id+speaker_labels+assigned_names. For voiceprint interviewer confirm: one label + real name on one interview after quote links; that identity backfills other interviews sharing voice_identity_id — re-list instead of confirming every card. set_voiceprint needs enabled bool (false purges biometric voice data). If need_approve_speakers=true, show quote links then assign_speakers when the user confirms. If transcript_quality.looks_corrupted=true, offer retranscribe with the correct language. write_notes and write_summary replace the entire notes or summary field (not append).
flags.hypothesis: Broad language may route a narrow task to an unnecessarily large response; bounded semantics may explain this language.
